original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Construct a saturated rank-four relation lattice whose cube vectors span it rationally but miss one parity direction; determine its exact cube intersection and missing-coset height.
scope_change_reason: Original lattice-obstruction side result after the proposed rank-three parity lemma was found already proved in Ali Romman's main-branch three-register package. No new register construction or predecessor replay is claimed.
bottleneck_link: The BIT relation-space method needs binary first-order directions. This example disproves an unrestricted extension of rational cube generation to a cube parity basis, and identifies a missing saturation premise at relation rank four. It supplies no paid saving.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved counterexample and its complete finite certificate. Leave ambient-dimension minimization and rank-one frame realization open.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the complete lattice identity, exact nine-element cube intersection, index-two defect and sharp height two. verify.py independently enumerates all 59049 ambient cube vectors, both sets of 210 maximal minors, a 6561-point coefficient box and eight sign-column omission controls.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: What is the smallest ambient dimension for a saturated rank-four lattice with a rationally spanning cube intersection that fails to span modulo two?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The ten-coordinate counterexample proves the parity reduction fails in general; a smaller example would sharpen word-length applicability.
open_questions.first_step: Classify rank-four saturated subspaces in dimensions five through nine, using signed coordinate symmetries and exact cube intersections.
open_questions.blocked_by: No exhaustive ambient-dimension lower bound is supplied.

open_questions.question: Can a lattice with this cube-parity defect occur as the complete relation lattice of rational rank-one matrix frames in a legal BIT word?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The current construction is an abstract torsion-free exponent quotient, not a physical or formal rank-one paid-frame construction.
open_questions.first_step: Write the ten frame generators in a basis of Z^10/L and impose rank-one minors on an injective rational matrix realization.
open_questions.blocked_by: Rank-one realization, scalar projector endpoint identity, native delivery and the complete invoice are unproved.
